title: 碾壓混凝土壩施工~Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction
focus: 碾壓層密實、材料配比與層間滲流的品質鏈~Quality links between RCC compaction, mixture proportions and interlift seepage
summary: 本課以碾壓混凝土壩施工為入口，深入碾壓層密實、材料配比與層間滲流的品質鏈。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction as its entry point, this course examines quality links between rcc compaction, mixture proportions and interlift seepage. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 鋪層節拍比較固定面積5000 m²及厚度0.3 m，因此需料1500 m³不變，只將有效供料率250增至300 m³/h。t=V/Q由6 h降至5 h，供料率增加20%而時間減少16.67%。模型仍未含邊緣修整、設備等待及接縫時間限制；增加供料不能被直接解讀為所有施工工序都縮短相同比例。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Keep lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m fixed, so volume remains 1500 m³, increasing only effective supply from 250 to 300 m³/h. Duration t=V/Q falls from 6 h to 5 h: 20% more supply gives 16.67% less time. Edge finishing, equipment queues and joint-time limits remain excluded; other construction tasks need not shorten by the same proportion.
history: 碾壓混凝土把土工式鋪層碾壓和水泥水化材料結合，品質核心由單一強度轉為材料、壓實與層面連續性的共同證據。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~RCC combines earthwork-style lift compaction with cement hydration, shifting quality evidence from strength alone toward materials, compaction and interlift continuity. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 鋪層體積與供料節拍~Lift volume and supply rhythm
units.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍~Lift volume and supply rhythm
units.mechanism: 碾壓混凝土以薄層連續鋪築形成大體積結構，層面暴露時間由面積和供料節拍共同決定。設備名義產能不等於可持續有效供料，需考慮運輸與等待。 假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。~RCC forms mass structures through thin successive lifts. Lift exposure depends on area and delivery rhythm, while rated plant capacity differs from sustainable placement because transport and queuing intervene. Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions. A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions.
units.verify: 以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。將最長暴露區的時間納入層面處理證據。~Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions. Include the longest-exposed region in the evidence for interface preparation.
units.failure: 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。~A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk.
units.misconception: 拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。~Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
units.practice: 以鋪層體積與供料節拍編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift volume and supply rhythm, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions.

units.anchor: 壓實度與參考密度~Compaction and reference density
units.title: 壓實度與參考密度~Compaction and reference density
units.mechanism: RCC密實程度影響孔隙、強度與滲透性，現場密度需對應代表性參考值。參考試體的含水量與級配不同時，密實度百分比會失去可比性。 假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。~RCC density influences voids, strength and permeability, and field density needs a representative reference. A percentage loses comparability if reference specimens differ in moisture or grading from the placed material. Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion. Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。核對粗骨材修正前後是否使用同一密度定義。~Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately. Check that density definitions remain consistent before and after coarse-aggregate correction.
units.failure: 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。~Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms.
units.misconception: 平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。~Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
units.practice: 以壓實度與參考密度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction and reference density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately.

units.anchor: 含水量與膠結比~Moisture and water-binder ratio
units.title: 含水量與膠結比~Moisture and water-binder ratio
units.mechanism: 含水不足會降低可壓實性，過多則改變骨架和漿體孔隙。總水量需含骨材自由水，不能只看拌合機外加水；吸收水與自由水的角色不同。 假設膠結材150 kg/m³、設計有效水90 kg/m³，w/b=0.60；骨材帶入自由水15 kg/m³時，外加水應為75 kg/m³，限已知吸水修正。 把吸收水全部當成可用拌合水會低估外加需求，雨後自由水未扣除則會提高有效水膠比。現場補水若未記錄，後續強度異常將難以追溯。~Too little water impairs compactability, while excess changes the aggregate skeleton and paste voids. Total mixing water includes aggregate free moisture, with absorbed and free water serving different roles. Assume binder 150 kg/m³ and effective water 90 kg/m³, giving w/b=0.60. Aggregate free water 15 kg/m³ leaves added water 75 kg/m³, with absorption already accounted for. Counting absorbed water as free mixing water understates additions, while failing to subtract rainwater increases effective ratio. Unrecorded field water makes later strength anomalies difficult to trace to their origin.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材150 kg/m³、設計有效水90 kg/m³，w/b=0.60；骨材帶入自由水15 kg/m³時，外加水應為75 kg/m³，限已知吸水修正。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 150 kg/m³ and effective water 90 kg/m³, giving w/b=0.60. Aggregate free water 15 kg/m³ leaves added water 75 kg/m³, with absorption already accounted for.
units.verify: 分別量測骨材含水和吸水率，核對外加水計量與批次修正；比較稠度、壓實反應和取芯品質，確認比例變化不是單純由濕骨材質量換算錯誤造成。以骨材乾質量重算含水修正避免濕重誤差。~Measure aggregate moisture and absorption separately and check metered additions and batch corrections. Compare consistency, compaction response and cores to ensure apparent ratio changes are not wet-mass conversion errors. Recalculate moisture corrections from dry aggregate mass to avoid wet-mass errors.
units.failure: 把吸收水全部當成可用拌合水會低估外加需求，雨後自由水未扣除則會提高有效水膠比。現場補水若未記錄，後續強度異常將難以追溯。~Counting absorbed water as free mixing water understates additions, while failing to subtract rainwater increases effective ratio. Unrecorded field water makes later strength anomalies difficult to trace to their origin.
units.misconception: 只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。~Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
units.practice: 以含水量與膠結比編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別量測骨材含水和吸水率，核對外加水計量與批次修正；比較稠度、壓實反應和取芯品質，確認比例變化不是單純由濕骨材質量換算錯誤造成。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for moisture and water-binder ratio, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure aggregate moisture and absorption separately and check metered additions and batch corrections. Compare consistency, compaction response and cores to ensure apparent ratio changes are not wet-mass conversion errors.

units.anchor: 壓實功與遍數解讀~Compaction effort and pass count
units.title: 壓實功與遍數解讀~Compaction effort and pass count
units.mechanism: 碾壓遍數是施工過程指標，不是材料狀態本身；振幅、頻率、速度、層厚及骨材都影響輸入和傳遞。增加遍數可能使密度趨於平台或造成粒料破碎。 假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。~Pass count describes process rather than material state. Amplitude, frequency, speed, thickness and aggregate affect energy transfer, while extra passes may reach a density plateau or crush particles. Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m. Nominal energy density is 400 kJ/m³, not entirely effective energy delivered to concrete. A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m. Nominal energy density is 400 kJ/m³, not entirely effective energy delivered to concrete.
units.verify: 在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。用粒徑變化確認碾壓是否正在破碎骨材。~Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage. Use grading changes to determine whether rolling is crushing aggregate particles.
units.failure: 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。~A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working.
units.misconception: 碾壓遍數越多就必然讓所有深度的品質持續提高。~More roller passes necessarily keep improving quality at every depth.
units.practice: 以壓實功與遍數解讀編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction effort and pass count, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage.

units.anchor: 砂漿體積與骨架空隙~Mortar volume and skeleton voids
units.title: 砂漿體積與骨架空隙~Mortar volume and skeleton voids
units.mechanism: 骨材骨架需要足夠砂漿填充空隙並形成黏結，砂漿過少可能留下連通孔隙。粗骨材堆積密度與級配影響所需體積，不能只以水泥重量評估。 假設每立方公尺粗骨材骨架空隙0.28 m³、有效砂漿0.31 m³，體積餘裕0.03 m³，即空隙的10.714%；不代表最佳配比。 砂漿充足不保證運輸後仍均勻分布，離析可在局部留下缺漿粗料。過多細料又可能增加需水與收縮，單一體積餘裕不能證明耐久性全面提升。~The aggregate skeleton needs mortar to fill voids and bond particles. Insufficient mortar can leave connected porosity, while packing density and grading control volume demand rather than cement mass alone. Assume coarse-skeleton voids 0.28 m³ per bulk cubic metre and effective mortar 0.31 m³. Margin is 0.03 m³, or 10.714 percent of void volume, not an optimum mix. Adequate total mortar does not ensure uniform distribution after transport; segregation can leave locally deficient coarse pockets. Excess fines increase water demand and shrinkage, so one volume margin does not demonstrate overall durability.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每立方公尺粗骨材骨架空隙0.28 m³、有效砂漿0.31 m³，體積餘裕0.03 m³，即空隙的10.714%；不代表最佳配比。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume coarse-skeleton voids 0.28 m³ per bulk cubic metre and effective mortar 0.31 m³. Margin is 0.03 m³, or 10.714 percent of void volume, not an optimum mix.
units.verify: 量測骨材堆積空隙並核對砂漿實際體積，將細料吸附與骨材形狀一起考慮；用取芯孔隙連通性和界面觀察檢查是否真正填滿，而不是只看外觀。比較缺漿區與完整區芯樣的連通孔隙差異。~Measure aggregate packing voids and actual mortar volume, considering fines adsorption and particle shape. Use core connectivity and interface observations to verify filling instead of relying on a smooth surface appearance. Compare connected voids in cores from mortar-deficient and intact regions.
units.failure: 砂漿充足不保證運輸後仍均勻分布，離析可在局部留下缺漿粗料。過多細料又可能增加需水與收縮，單一體積餘裕不能證明耐久性全面提升。~Adequate total mortar does not ensure uniform distribution after transport; segregation can leave locally deficient coarse pockets. Excess fines increase water demand and shrinkage, so one volume margin does not demonstrate overall durability.
units.misconception: 總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。~Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.
units.practice: 以砂漿體積與骨架空隙編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。量測骨材堆積空隙並核對砂漿實際體積，將細料吸附與骨材形狀一起考慮；用取芯孔隙連通性和界面觀察檢查是否真正填滿，而不是只看外觀。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for mortar volume and skeleton voids, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure aggregate packing voids and actual mortar volume, considering fines adsorption and particle shape. Use core connectivity and interface observations to verify filling instead of relying on a smooth surface appearance.

units.anchor: 層間黏結與有效齡期~Interlift bond and exposure age
units.title: 層間黏結與有效齡期~Interlift bond and exposure age
units.mechanism: 相鄰層的黏結受暴露溫度、時間、表面乾燥與處理影響，不只是日曆時間。等效齡期可比較熱歷程，但接縫強度仍需同材料與同處理試驗。 假設簡化反應速率每升10 K加倍，基準20°C，30°C暴露4 h相當20°C的8 h；僅教學Q10模型，非接縫接受時間。 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。~Interlift bond depends on exposure temperature, duration, drying and treatment rather than clock time alone. Equivalent age compares thermal histories, while bond strength still needs tests of the same materials and interface preparation. Assume a simplified reaction rate doubling per ten kelvin above 20°C. Four hours at 30°C equals eight hours at 20°C, a teaching Q10 model rather than an interface acceptance time. At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化反應速率每升10 K加倍，基準20°C，30°C暴露4 h相當20°C的8 h；僅教學Q10模型，非接縫接受時間。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a simplified reaction rate doubling per ten kelvin above 20°C. Four hours at 30°C equals eight hours at 20°C, a teaching Q10 model rather than an interface acceptance time.
units.verify: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。在相同表面處理下分別比較不同溫度歷程。~Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range. Compare different temperature histories while holding interface preparation conditions constant.
units.failure: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。~At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.
units.misconception: 等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。~Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions.
units.practice: 以層間黏結與有效齡期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for interlift bond and exposure age, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range.

units.anchor: 層狀滲透異向性~Layered permeability anisotropy
units.title: 層狀滲透異向性~Layered permeability anisotropy
units.mechanism: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。層狀介質的等效滲透率須依平行或垂直流向計算。 假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。~Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. Equivalent permeability of layers differs for flow parallel and perpendicular to them. Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s. A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. Directly extrapolating intact small specimens to the dam understates scale and interface effects.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s.
units.verify: 按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。把芯樣中實際穿越的層面數量清楚列出。~Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head. Overlay drain locations with interfaces and determine whether fracture flow has exceeded the assumptions of a homogeneous Darcy model. State clearly how many actual lift interfaces each tested core crosses.
units.failure: 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。~A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. Directly extrapolating intact small specimens to the dam understates scale and interface effects.
units.misconception: 垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。~Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
units.practice: 以層狀滲透異向性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for layered permeability anisotropy, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head. Overlay drain locations with interfaces and determine whether fracture flow has exceeded the assumptions of a homogeneous Darcy model.

units.anchor: 上下游面層協調~Facing and RCC compatibility
units.title: 上下游面層協調~Facing and RCC compatibility
units.mechanism: 面層和內部RCC可能具有不同彈性、收縮與溫度歷程，接合區需傳遞相對變形。外表平整不能證明內部相容，尤其在澆置時間錯開時。 假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。~Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement. A smooth exterior does not establish compatibility, especially with different placement times. Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution. An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution.
units.verify: 同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。將兩側應變轉成相對位移檢查接合相容。~Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Use interface cores and crack patterns to assess compatibility, comparing free-shrinkage specimens separately from restrained field behavior. Convert strains on both sides into relative movement to check interface compatibility.
units.failure: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。~An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.
units.misconception: 面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。~Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface.
units.practice: 以上下游面層協調編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for facing and rcc compatibility, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Use interface cores and crack patterns to assess compatibility, comparing free-shrinkage specimens separately from restrained field behavior.

units.anchor: 邊緣壓實與死角~Edge compaction and restricted zones
units.title: 邊緣壓實與死角~Edge compaction and restricted zones
units.mechanism: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。中部試驗成果不能直接代表受限空間，幾何可達性是品質控制的一部分。 假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。 體積占比小但若沿上游形成連續通道，可能主導滲流而非平均強度。以隨機中部取樣代表全部工程，會系統性漏掉可達性不足造成的缺陷。~Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. Central trial results do not represent these areas, making geometric access part of quality control. Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible. A small-volume band can dominate seepage if continuous near the upstream face. Random sampling confined to central areas systematically misses defects caused by restricted equipment access along the structure.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible.
units.verify: 把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。追蹤弱帶是否在上下相鄰層形成連續通道。~Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts. Trace whether weak bands connect into continuous paths across adjacent lifts.
units.failure: 體積占比小但若沿上游形成連續通道，可能主導滲流而非平均強度。以隨機中部取樣代表全部工程，會系統性漏掉可達性不足造成的缺陷。~A small-volume band can dominate seepage if continuous near the upstream face. Random sampling confined to central areas systematically misses defects caused by restricted equipment access along the structure.
units.misconception: 邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。~A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
units.practice: 以邊緣壓實與死角編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for edge compaction and restricted zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts.

units.anchor: 強度抽樣與空間變異~Strength sampling and spatial variability
units.title: 強度抽樣與空間變異~Strength sampling and spatial variability
units.mechanism: 試體平均強度描述中心趨勢，離散程度和空間分布決定是否存在局部弱區。相同平均值可能對應完全不同品質穩定性，取樣須與施工批次對應。 假設強度平均20 MPa、標準差3 MPa，變異係數15%；採教學常態近似，第五百分位20−1.645×3=15.065 MPa，非規範設計值。 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。~Mean specimen strength describes central tendency, while variability and location reveal weak zones. Equal means can hide different consistency, so samples must be linked to placement batches and spatial positions. Assume mean strength 20 MPa and standard deviation 3 MPa, giving coefficient of variation fifteen percent. A teaching normal fifth percentile is 15.065 MPa, not a code design value. Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設強度平均20 MPa、標準差3 MPa，變異係數15%；採教學常態近似，第五百分位20−1.645×3=15.065 MPa，非規範設計值。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume mean strength 20 MPa and standard deviation 3 MPa, giving coefficient of variation fifteen percent. A teaching normal fifth percentile is 15.065 MPa, not a code design value.
units.verify: 保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。核對低強度樣本是否集中於相同材料批次。~Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum. Check whether low-strength specimens cluster within the same material batch.
units.failure: 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。~Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme.
units.misconception: 平均強度相同就代表兩個施工區具有完全相同品質穩定性。~Equal mean strength means two construction zones have identical quality consistency.
units.practice: 以強度抽樣與空間變異編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for strength sampling and spatial variability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum.

facts: 教學1500 m³薄層以250 m³/h供應需6 h。~A teaching 1500 m³ lift at 250 m³/h requires 6 h.
教學乾密度比得到96.667%密實度，非接受標準。~Teaching dry-density ratio gives 96.667 percent compaction, not an acceptance standard.
教學自由水修正後外加水75 kg/m³。~Teaching free-moisture correction leaves added water 75 kg/m³.
教學名義壓實能量密度400 kJ/m³。~Teaching nominal compaction energy density is 400 kJ/m³.
教學異向層狀垂直滲透率1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。~Teaching layered perpendicular permeability is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s.
教學常態第五百分位強度15.065 MPa，非設計值。~Teaching normal fifth-percentile strength is 15.065 MPa, not a design value.
